name: Trace-driven tuning loops
summary: A loop that changes the harness configuration from observed failures in run traces and keeps the cost and quality winners, as in HarnessPro (arXiv 2610.26770) and similar research systems. Assess: research-grade and costly to run. If built, it is v8.3 or later, opt-in and propose-only; the bench plus a human decision is the simpler alternative.

evidence.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26770 (HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs)
evidence.setting: Research system; its results aren't recorded in the v8 docs, so only the mechanism is used here
evidence.effect: Changes the harness, not the weights, from observed failures, keeping configurations on the cost-quality Pareto front

revisit: an independent replication saving 15% or more at non-inferior quality
